title: HK-87 Assassin Droid
description: Morgan Elsbeth employed HK-87 Droids to defend her interests on Calodan and after as well. They were excellent fighters and purpose-built for assassination. They worked for Elsbeth as tireless bodyguards and enforcers until they met a superior foe. One of Elsbeth's HK-87 assassin droids was dispatched to the shipyards on Corellia to aid Marrok in his mission and fight against Ahsoka Tano.
